title: The twin end to end, on real sensors
description: The digital twin end to end (#84): a simulated sensor stream with a known truth, and a real public gauge. **The simulated stream** is the heated channel -- two temperature sensors around a fouling wall conductance -- with process noise, a known drift of that conductance and an injected spike. The truth is known by construction, so every check the workflow makes is *scored*: NIS against its chi-squ
